21 New Flagship Grok Voices | SpaceXAI

# 21 New Flagship Grok Voices

New multilingual voices for Grok Voice, plus improved naturalness for the original five.

Today, we're releasing 21 new flagship voices for Grok Voice, joining the original five. All of them are multilingual and available now in the realtime Voice Agent API , the Text to Speech API , and the new Grok Voice Agent Builder . Meet the newcomers in the lineup:

Soft, empathetic, and soothing.

## A voice for every use case

Each voice was cast for a specific job: support, characters, commentary, advertising, education. Speech tags like [pause] and <whisper> can be used to control the delivery. Hear five of them in their element:

Thanks for your patience — I found the issue. [pause] Your account was still on the legacy plan, so I've moved you over and <emphasis> applied the credit to this month. </emphasis> <soft> You're all set. </soft> Anything else I can take care of?

Every voice is natively multilingual, supporting all of Grok Voice's 25+ languages.

English Arabic Bengali Chinese French German Hindi Indonesian Italian Japanese Korean Portuguese Russian Spanish Turkish

闭上 眼睛， 静静 聆听 片刻。 每 一个 声音 都在 讲述 一个 故事， 每 一个 故事 都 值得 被 倾听。 无论 你 身在 世界 的 哪个 角落， 我 都很 高兴 你在 这里。

## Improved naturalness for the original five

Ara, Eve, Leo, Rex, and Sal got an upgrade alongside the new voices. They've been retrained with an improved recipe, so pacing, phrasing, and emphasis are more natural.

To build a custom voice agent with one of the new voices, use the Grok Voice Agent Builder in the xAI console . You can also clone your own voice from about a minute of audio.
